# TeamShift — a team sharing a factor: shift the clock, the team stays put, the last runner moves

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** planned: conditional · **Diagram:** [The Lonely Runner: pile-ups, shifts and residue sieves](../../GRAPH.md#the-lonely-runner-pile-ups-shifts-and-residue-sieves)

Normalize so the runner to be lonely stands still. Suppose all moving runners but one share a common factor, while all speeds together share none. Take a good time for the team (from the conjecture for one runner fewer) and step the clock forward by multiples of one over the shared factor: every team runner returns to the same place, and the last runner moves among evenly spaced spots, one of which is good. So the set is lonely. Rosenfeld 2025, Lemma 5. The working form of Geo's team (co-dependent) idea: the team need not be at the start, only already well spread. Conditional: the conjecture for one runner fewer is a named hypothesis.
